question: In certain cases it is necessary to carry out previous treatments with oxidizing or reducing agents in redox evaluations in order to:

options.opa: Transform the analyte to an adequate oxidation state for subsequent evaluation.
options.opb: Ensure that all the analyte is in solution.
options.opc: Prepare the indicator solution so that it correctly rotates at the end point.
options.opd: Make the reaction between titrator and analyte complete.
options.ope: Improve the accuracy of the assessment.
